versions.changelog:
- Add an on-demand, read-only GitHub release checker, bundled version metadata, and bilingual update instructions.
- Simplify English and Chinese onboarding and add reusable cross-platform learning prompts.
- Handle unavailable checks explicitly, including offline, rate-limit, certificate, and invalid-release responses; preserve existing mentors and learning records.

- Add a tested, tag-triggered release workflow with GitHub archives, SHA-256 checksums, ClawHub publishing, and a manual marketplace checklist.
- Package a self-contained skill for skills.sh, Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw, including its scripts, templates, and references.
- Add English and Simplified Chinese READMEs, a new technical visual identity, and transparent platform support information.
- Add an English mentor template, language-aware learning summaries, and multilingual chapter validation while preserving existing learning records.
Initial public release: source-grounded book-to-mentor conversion, guided practice, learning records, and cross-agent packaging.
